about.description:

for it exists.

Activate it by adding this to your .zshrc:

  source "${CONDA_PREFIX}/share/zsh/plugins/zsh-you-should-use/you-should-use.plugin.zsh"
about.summary: Zsh plugin that reminds you to use existing aliases

build.script:
install -d "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}"
install -m 644 you-should-use.plugin.zsh "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}/"
# upstream ships the second name as a symlink; ship a plain copy instead
install -m 644 you-should-use.plugin.zsh \
  "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}/zsh-you-should-use.plugin.zsh"

name: zsh-you-should-use
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.11.1"
  plugin_dir: share/zsh/plugins/zsh-you-should-use

package:
  name: zsh-you-should-use
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/MichaelAquilina/zsh-you-should-use/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4d884aed12f1301f4620888e322c406c215b719e49385aa3088dc84c8ed383ed

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  script: |
    install -d "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}"
    install -m 644 you-should-use.plugin.zsh "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}/"
    # upstream ships the second name as a symlink; ship a plain copy instead
    install -m 644 you-should-use.plugin.zsh \
      "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}/zsh-you-should-use.plugin.zsh"

requirements:
  run:
    - __unix
    - zsh >=5.1
    - ncurses  # provides `tput`, used to colour the reminder

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - ${{ plugin_dir }}/you-should-use.plugin.zsh
        - ${{ plugin_dir }}/zsh-you-should-use.plugin.zsh
  - script: |
      zsh -f -c 'source "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}/you-should-use.plugin.zsh"; [[ "${YSU_VERSION}" == "${{ version }}" ]]'

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/MichaelAquilina/zsh-you-should-use
  summary: Zsh plugin that reminds you to use existing aliases
  description: |
    Prints a reminder whenever a command is typed in full although an alias
    for it exists.

    Activate it by adding this to your .zshrc:

      source "${CONDA_PREFIX}/share/zsh/plugins/zsh-you-should-use/you-should-use.plugin.zsh"
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/MichaelAquilina/zsh-you-should-use

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ManuelLerchner
